patterns.mobile_menu_pattern: The dashboard uses a hamburger button in the header that triggers a slide-in sidebar on mobile. The header has an onMenuClick callback and the sidebar manages open/closed state with animations.
patterns.component_structure: Client components use 'use client' directive at the top. SVG icons are inline. Tailwind classes follow the project's primary/secondary color scheme.
patterns.navigation_links: Desktop navigation is in a div with 'hidden md:flex' class. Mobile shows different content with 'md:hidden' class.
patterns.responsive_design: Uses Tailwind responsive prefixes (md:, lg:) with mobile-first approach

existing_implementations.description: Dashboard already has a complete mobile menu implementation with hamburger button and slide-in sidebar
key_features: Hamburger button with SVG icon (3 horizontal lines)
onClick handler to open mobile menu
